# WO-114: Shared Codex/Claude team workflow document (CODEX-035 item 3)
Status: done (superseded 2026-11-12: docs/vendor/WORKFLOW.md not landed; the process lives in docs/SDLC.md and docs/vendor/AGENT_CHANNEL.md)
Vendor: codex
Agent: lead
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (channel)
Assigned to: Codex channel session (Nora dispatches)
Source: docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md CODEX-035 item 3 (accepted in CLAUDE-016)

## Goal
The user approved one shared workflow for both teams. Write docs/vendor/WORKFLOW.md: kanban lifecycle (icebox, proposed, accepted, WO written, worktree cut, in progress, delivered, owner review, merged, closed), how a CP becomes a WO, icebox tickets, WIP limits (Codex: at most 4 active WOs plus 1 docs WO; in-house sets its own), checkpoint cadence (each side reads the other's channel file at every checkpoint), cross-team ownership (path reservations, stay-off lists, who may write which file), and escalation (scope questions go to Morgan in the channel; workers never widen scope themselves). Link it from BOARD.md and CODEX_PROPOSALS.md. Describe the process as it actually works today (channel files, tools/vendor.sh, owner-only git/push/merge); do not invent tooling.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- WORKFLOW.md exists, under 250 lines, plain words, every rule matches docs/VENDOR.md and the channel files (cite them).
- BOARD.md and CODEX_PROPOSALS.md link to it; no other content in them changes except a new icebox section in BOARD.md if useful.
- No rule grants vendors git, push, merge, network or in-house paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- docs/vendor/WORKFLOW.md (new)
- docs/vendor/BOARD.md
- docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
docs/VENDOR.md, docs/vendor/codex-team/, CLAUDE_TO_CODEX.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/, tools/. Changes to the in-house process are proposals in the doc, marked as such, for Morgan to accept.

## Check-in plan
Report in docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md when done. Worktree: .vendor-wt/wo-114, cut from main by the owner.
